classifications.notes: proof_certificate_store.py moves immutable certificate bytes by strict CIDv1 sha2-256 multihash checks. Local storage and IPFS are opt-in; never starts a daemon; never uses legacy testing pseudo-CIDs. Transport is not cryptographic verification and not reuse admission.
Cold discovery of named Kubo/Lotus/Iroh executables only. Never executes binaries, starts daemons, or inspects ~/.ipfs.

profile_d_policy.py is the single MCP Profile D provider. Delegates evaluation to ipfs_datasets_py and refuses policy-governed execution when unavailable. Not a second deontic evaluator; unavailable evaluator raises rather than inventing allow.

mcplusplus/artifacts.py builds Kubo-conformant CIDv1 raw/sha2-256 intent/decision/output/receipt/event envelopes. Decision and receipt builders leave signatures as empty lists; unsigned receipts remain unsigned.

Immutable CID block store with rebuildable SQLite indexes for Profile G claims/leases/health. Local durable write is first; optional backend repairs local copy. CID mismatch raises ArtifactIntegrityError. Not a proof-seal acceptance authority.

event_dag.py Profile F hot/cold retention with Merkle helpers (build_merkle_tree, merkle_proof, verify_merkle_proof). Default certificate is hash commitment, not ZK. Optional MCPPP_PROFILE_F_ZK path delegates to datasets provider and remains unavailable without real artifacts.
iroh/release.py validates packaged stage-aware readiness and IROH-027 receipts (test/benchmark/security). Stage-aware approval is not cryptographic proof of execution.

install_lotus.py installs Lotus binaries and can download Filecoin proving parameters via download_params when operators opt in. auto_install_deps defaults off; IPFS_KIT_AUTO_INSTALL_LOTUS_DEPS is required for dependency auto-install. Not automatic proof setup and not a proving backend.
